sources.title: Hugging Face debuts Microduck, an adorable $399 waddling robot
sources.snippet: Hugging Face on Thursday announced " Microduck ," a small, armless robot capable of waddling adorably and picking up small objects with an articulated beak that doubles as a gripper.

sources.title: Microduck - A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI ...
sources.snippet: Microduck - A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI experimentation and fun Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face have unveiled the Microduck, a 25 cm tall biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, a depth sensor, two motion sensors, and an articulated beak that can pick up objects.
